name: REVIVE
question: Does on-demand avanafil improve erectile function over placebo in men with erectile dysfunction?

design.population: 646 adult men with mild to severe erectile dysfunction were randomized.
design.locator: Goldstein 2012 PubMed abstract, Methods; ClinicalTrials.gov NCT00790751, Participant Flow

verdictNote: All three doses improved the coprimary measures over placebo at 12 weeks.
takeaway: In REVIVE, on-demand avanafil 50, 100 or 200 mg improved successful penetration, successful intercourse and IIEF erectile-function scores over placebo after 12 weeks in men with erectile dysfunction.

reports.label: Initial randomized report
reports.citation: Goldstein I, McCullough AR, Jones LA, et al. "A Randomized, Double-Blind, Placebo-Controlled Evaluation of the Safety and Efficacy of Avanafil in Subjects with Erectile Dysfunction." *J Sex Med.* 2012;9(4):1122-1133. doi:10.1111/j.1743-6109.2011.02629.x

results.measure: Mean change in percentage of attempts with successful vaginal penetration at 12 weeks

effect.p: ≤0.001 for each avanafil dose versus placebo

results.note: The abstract does not give dose-specific absolute changes.
results.locator: PubMed abstract, Main Outcome Measures and Results

results.measure: Mean change in percentage of attempts with successful intercourse at 12 weeks

effect.p: ≤0.001 for each avanafil dose versus placebo

results.note: The abstract does not give dose-specific absolute changes.
results.locator: PubMed abstract, Main Outcome Measures and Results

results.measure: Change in International Index of Erectile Function erectile-function domain at 12 weeks

effect.p: ≤0.001 for each avanafil dose versus placebo

results.note: The abstract does not give dose-specific absolute changes.
results.locator: PubMed abstract, Main Outcome Measures and Results

results.measure: Successful intercourse among attempts within 15 minutes after dosing
results.note: 300 attempts in this interval; abstract gives a dose range, not dose-specific rates or denominators.

results.measure: Successful intercourse among attempts more than 6 hours after dosing
results.note: 80 attempts in this interval; abstract gives a dose range, not dose-specific rates or denominators.

harms.label: Commonly reported adverse events
harms.note: Across avanafil-treated men: headache, flushing, and nasal congestion.

delivery.label: On-demand dosing
delivery.value: Study drug 30 minutes before sexual activity; at least 12 hours between doses; no food or alcohol restriction.

reports.label: 52-week open-label extension
reports.citation: Belkoff LH, McCullough A, Goldstein I, et al. "An Open-Label, Long-Term Evaluation of the Safety, Efficacy and Tolerability of Avanafil in Male Patients with Mild to Severe Erectile Dysfunction." *Int J Clin Pract.* 2013;67(4):333-341. doi:10.1111/ijcp.12065
reports.followUp: 52-week open-label extension of REVIVE and a separate diabetes trial

results.measure: Successful intercourse in the extension, baseline to follow-up
results.note: In the 52-week extension of two trials, SEP3 success rose from 13% to 68% in the 100-mg group and from 11% to 66% in the 100/200-mg group.

results.measure: Mean erectile-function domain score in the extension, baseline to follow-up
results.note: In the 52-week extension of two trials, mean IIEF-EF rose from 13.6 to 22.2 in the 100-mg group and from 11.9 to 22.7 in the 100/200-mg group.

harms.label: Discontinuation because of adverse events
harms.note: Fewer than 3% of 712 enrollees in the 52-week extension of two trials discontinued because of adverse events.

delivery.label: Extension enrollment and dose adjustment
delivery.value: 712 enrolled; 686 contributed efficacy data. All started avanafil 100 mg and could request 200 mg for efficacy or 50 mg for tolerability.
